title: scrollcase workspace configuration
description: Declares where a project keeps its Runtime Box scrolls and where the builder writes its artefacts. Lives at the root of the project that consumes scrollcase, never inside scrollcase itself. Every field is optional; omitted paths fall back to the built-in defaults, and relative paths resolve against the directory holding this file.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor completion and validation.

paths.description: Workspace directories. A relative value resolves against the project root; an absolute value is used as given.

build.description: Scratch space where the box payload tree is assembled. Generated; do not commit.

dist.description: Output directory for archives, signed documents, and upload objects. Generated; do not commit.

keys.description: Directory for local development signing keys. Never used for production releases; do not commit.
